primer: Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) is the premier enterprise software and cloud computing monopoly in global commerce. In audited fiscal 2026, Microsoft generated $331.84 billion in revenue (+17.8% YoY) and $155.24 billion in operating profit at a record 46.78% operating margin. The business is backed by $182.94 billion in operating cash flow and an S&P AAA-rated balance sheet holding $36.55 billion in net cash reserves. At $523.00, the stock trades at 27.31x trailing earnings on an orderly Stage 2 consolidation shelf just +1.52% above its 10-week EMA. We assign an earned new-capital verdict of IMMEDIATE_BUY with Tier 1 conviction and a Base Target of $660.00.
